en-IN.name: IELTS and German Coach
en-IN.summary: IELTS Speaking mock tests, listening drills and beginner German lessons.
en-IN.description: A personal practice coach. Run a full IELTS Speaking mock test with an AI examiner's feedback, practise one part at a time, train your ear with IELTS-style listening drills in British, Australian and American accents, and learn beginner German with a native German voice.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask study coach for a mock test
Alexa, ask study coach for a German lesson
